readerCopy.body: Attraction and approval can expose a desire that has been made smaller for so long that simply wanting it feels disruptive. When Venus conjoins Lilith, connection and autonomy fuse, bringing relationships, money, pleasure, style, and personal preference into contact with the part that refuses to keep choosing for approval alone. The desire does not become wise simply because it is honest. Its return is still important information about what the old arrangement may have required people to suppress.
